description: The University of Cádiz publishes grid voltage and frequency measurements acquired in its computational instrumentation and industrial electronics research group during November 2021. Harvard Dataverse provides five data files under CC0 for free access. Frequency records use a conventional ten-second calculation and a one-second Allan-variance method; voltage statistics summarise one-cycle, ten-cycle and two-second analyses. CSV and tab-separated tables include headers and local timestamps. These site-specific observations can calibrate power-quality simulations and compare statistical indicators of supply disturbances. The one-second database write limit means shorter-window statistics are aggregated before storage, and the records do not represent continuous waveform samples. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Replication Data for: Statistical dataset and acquisition system for grid voltage and frequency monitoring in a Python-Grafana environment
